note: Policy approval lives in the sparring service; a real sparring round writes a session row and calls Bedrock, so staging probes stay read-only (the route is mounted and rejects a call without the service token). Policy approval, the escalation path, the reconciler check and the migration are proven by Jest and the throwaway-Postgres harness.

tests.name: the sparring route is mounted and requires the service token

tests.reason: Policy approval only for converged sessions that asked for converged-auto-v1; escalated never; owner approval and new rounds refused after it; reconciler detects a policy approval on a non-converged session; migration contract + log/enforce gate on Postgres
